fields.description: Daily: overdue follow-ups escalated to managers. Weekly (Monday): cold prospects, customers not visited, principal-wise pending actions. Quarterly: customer data still missing. Each goes as a bell notification and an email.
fields.label: Reminders

fields.description: Untick to send the reminders as bell notifications only.
fields.label: Also Send Reminders by Email

fields.description: A follow-up still open this many days after its date is escalated to the managers.
fields.label: Escalate Follow-ups After (Days)

fields.description: A Prospect with no visit for this many days is reported as gone cold.
fields.label: Prospect Gone Cold After (Days)

fields.description: An Active Customer with no visit for this many days is reported as not visited.
fields.label: Customer Not Visited After (Days)

fields.description: Visit Reports older than this (from the day they were entered) can be changed only by a Sales Manager or an admin.
fields.label: Lock Entries for Salespeople After (Days)
